title: Scan in progress
trigger: A library or import-adjacent scan task is running
notes: Live panel only; ScanProgressDock remains

title: Import in progress
trigger: An import.movies task is running
notes: Show completed/total files when metadata exists

title: Movie scrape in progress
trigger: A tracked scrape.movie task is running
notes: Uses tracked activeTask even when dock is hidden; scrape queue listing waits on REQ-0023

title: Library storage offline
trigger: A configured library root is offline mismatched missing or denied
notes: Library availability not settings ops; auto-clear when paths are online

title: Movie import failed
trigger: import.movies ends failed
notes: Dismiss suppresses for this session

title: Movie import partial failure
trigger: import.movies ends partial_failed

title: Library scan failed
trigger: scan.library ends failed
notes: Whole-scan failure not a zero-change success

title: Manual scan completed
trigger: User-started scan.library completes
notes: No red badge even when useful

title: Movie scrape completed
trigger: Tracked scrape.movie completes
notes: Optional detail route is navigation not a todo

title: Movie scrape failed
trigger: Tracked scrape.movie fails or is cancelled
notes: Single-title failure is notify; systemic scrape outage is future MSG

title: Movie import completed
trigger: import.movies completes with no remaining failures

title: App update available
trigger: GitHub release is newer than the installed package
notes: Install stays in Settings About; sidebar New may remain

title: Actor scrape completed
trigger: Auto actor profile scrape fills missing avatar or summary

title: Actor scrape failed
trigger: Auto actor profile scrape fails
notes: Not needs-you; retry lives on the actor card

title: Library watch scan digest
trigger: fsnotify scan.library completes with imported or updated files
notes: Same group collapses a burst into one recent row

title: Library watch scrape digest
trigger: fsnotify-linked scrape.movie reaches a terminal status
notes: Burst of per-movie scrapes share one recent row

title: Manual scan started
trigger: User starts a library scan
notes: Toast only; Now section covers in-progress

title: Watch scan with no changes
trigger: fsnotify scan finds zero imported or updated files
notes: May already be suppressed near a changed scan

title: Storage rebind succeeded
trigger: User rebinds a library path to the current volume
notes: Settings ops confirmation stays on the page plus toast

title: Actor scrape started
trigger: Auto actor scrape begins

title: Settings operations family
trigger: Backup health-scan provider-ping proxy-test CSV-export and similar Settings actions finish
notes: Family row; add a dedicated MSG before promoting any ops result to notify

title: Library mutation family
trigger: Favorite tag trash restore saved-view and similar in-page mutations finish
notes: Page already shows the new state

title: Player handoff family
trigger: Native player launch HLS fallback or transient playback errors
notes: Sustained cannot-play state would need its own MSG before needs-you

title: ScanProgressDock live progress
trigger: Tracked scan or import progress while a dock consumer is active
notes: Dock stays; message center Now is the sentence form of the same live task
